summary:
Very thin cycle: only 3 research items cleared the filter out of 60 raw tweets over the 4-day window (57 dropped as empty-banks noise — almost entirely MikeZaccardi price-chart/meme volume; no neilksethi/neilksethinew items this cycle).

Apollo's Slok flags that the US government failed to term out its debt when rates were near zero and now pays 3.6% of GDP in net interest. Citi's US Earnings Revisions Index has been positive for 21 straight weeks, the longest stretch since September 2021 — a constructive breadth signal. RBC, meanwhile, flags growing correction risk for the S&P 500.

Counts: Apollo/Slok 1, Citi 1, RBC 1.
